title: Build the two-class first loop with supplies, recovery foundations and scale evidence
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Adds a shared offline/Colyseus first loop for Soldier and Medic against Hollow Constable in Gatehouse, with public/private rooms, reconnect, votes, shops/skills, illustrated setup, build grades and later-phase/Brutal attacks. Includes eight usable supplies, bounded admission/cold-start UX, projectile pooling and limited north/south walk strips. Protocol 4. Other classes/maps/routes remain visibly In production.

Publishes the anonymous development Practice playtest at https://grave-accord-playtest.ivoryflame12.chatgpt.site/ against the existing eight-slot Render Free service. Corrects production capacity/online Practice copy and delivers private codes/bootstrap after the client ready handshake. The frontend deployment remains 33b36bc while Sites access is unavailable. Gameplay source dfade88 is live; a brief hosted public/private SDK handshake passes and all test slots are released. No fifty-player hosted-capacity claim is made.

Adds signed multiplayer boundaries, a transactional SQL ledger, authenticated bounded HTTP transport and a server lifecycle journal. Local tests include separate-process HTTP/SQLite restart, competing claims, response-loss retry, lease renewal, preserved purchase history and stale/finalized-owner rejection. A server-only factory now connects the journal to GraveRoom, freezing safe transitions until acknowledgement and reporting latched outages. Normal/public execution leaves the factory disabled; hosted D1, participant/new-transport binding, historical roster and global rankings remain unfinished.

Validation: 74 rules/real-WebSocket/HTTP/SQL tests, strict TypeScript, 15-locale/content checks and production build. Assistant browser evidence covers earlier public gameplay and desktop votes/grades/walls/phases/supplies. Current supported browser control has regressed despite the user's working preview; new copy is not rendered-verified. Historical pooled foreground evidence is separate from the current protocol-4 server repeat: 49+1, exactly 4,000 hostiles/fifty active for 90 seconds, server p99 19.772 ms/max 37.428 ms; current foreground FPS remains unestablished. See FIRST_PLAYABLE.md and RECOVERY_IMPLEMENTATION.md.

Keep draft: full content/action art, physical phone/controller/human/native-language evidence, full capacity/endurance, live recovery/rankings and Windows/offline/LAN/final release gates remain open. Progress toward #4 and #5; their acceptance criteria remain open. Preserves original work and historical sealed Stage 1 artifacts.

Published all fifteen canonical runtime Wiki pages and verified their Git blobs plus public home/controls links. The user confirmed the existing Site is owned by another ChatGPT account; Sites publication needs legitimate access under that identity. Browser control remains a separate unresolved enablement failure even after explicit @Browser selection.
